jobs.occupation: Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Airbus Interior Noise department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Acoustics Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Interior Noise department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.01.2027
- Duration: 6 months

We are offering a Master Thesis opportunity focusing on acoustics, specifically interior noise. This role provides a unique chance to contribute to cutting-edge aerospace research and development within a leading global company.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Conducting in-depth research and analysis of interior noise sources and propagation within aircraft cabins.
- Developing and applying advanced simulation models and experimental methodologies for acoustic analysis.
- Evaluating and comparing different noise reduction strategies and materials.* Collecting and analyzing data from various sources, including laboratory tests and flight measurements.
- Documenting research findings and presenting results in a clear and concise manner.
- Collaborating with experienced engineers and researchers within the acoustics department.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, or a related field.
- Strong academic record with a focus on acoustics, vibrations, or signal processing.
- Proficiency in relevant software tools (e.g., MATLAB, ANSYS, COMSOL, LMS Test.Lab) is a plus.
- Experience with experimental acoustics and data acquisition systems is beneficial.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; German language skills are a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

In this role within our Supply Chain Management department, focusing on Cabin Equipment & Galley Catering, you will manage and monitor supplier groups to enforce compliance, conformance, and performance standards. You will act as the key operational interface to ensure on-time, on-quality, and cost-effective delivery of products and services, coordinating cross-functional teams to drive continuous supplier improvement, risk mitigation, and operational excellence.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working (up to 40%), part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Contract & Performance Management: Manage supply chain and quality aspects of contracts, taking full operational responsibility for supplier On Time, On Quality, and On Cost (OQOT/OC) performance
- Supplier Quality & Approval: Manage supplier quality approvals and ensure suppliers remain fully compliant with required certifications in close coordination with relevant stakeholders
- Industrial Qualification & NPI: Monitor and support new product introductions (NPI), Transfer of Work (ToW), and design changes to guarantee industrial qualification maturity before serial production
- Assessment, Risk & Development: Evaluate supplier capacity and capabilities, identify industrial risks, implement short-term recovery plans, and lead continuous performance improvement projects
- Stakeholder Coordination: Serve as the central operational interface to suppliers, coordinating internal stakeholders and ensuring seamless alignment with Multi-Functional and Divisional Teams (MFT/MDT)
- Tendering & Reporting: Assess suppliers during the tendering phase to inform selection decisions, and regularly report on operational supplier performance using standard management tools

Desired skills and qualifications

Technical competencies

- Quality Management: Strong knowledge of standard quality methods and tools
- IT & Office Tools: Proficiency in standard productivity software (Microsoft / Google Workspace)
- ERP Systems: Solid understanding and practical experience with generic ERP systems

Soft Skills:

- Autonomous Execution: Independently coordinating complex tasks and teams
- Stakeholder Management: Leading internal alignment and serving as the key contact for suppliers
- Stress Resilience & Negotiation: Composed under pressure and highly skilled in negotiation

Nice to have: Knowledge of or previous experience with specific Airbus Tools

Language Proficiency:

- English: Professional fluency required
